project_type: Marketing website. TanStack Start (SSR) on Vite 8, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4 (CSS-first config in src/styles.css, no tailwind.config), TanStack Router file-based routing. Deployed to Railway via Nixpacks/Nitro node-server.
build_system: npm scripts backed by Vite. dev: `vite dev` (port 8080); build: `vite build`; typecheck: `tsc --noEmit`; lint: `eslint .`; test: `vitest run`. The Lovable vite config wrapper (@lovable.dev/vite-tanstack-config) plus @tanstack/router-plugin regenerate src/routeTree.gen.ts during `vite dev`/`vite build` (NOT during `tsc --noEmit`).
test_framework: vitest run (node environment; no jsdom project configured). Existing tests: src/lib/site-data.test.ts, src/lib/motion.test.ts, src/lib/submission-guards.test.ts. They assert data-model invariants and pure functions, not React rendering.
build_command: cd demaze-website && NODE_OPTIONS= npm run build  (CANNOT run in this sandbox - see environment_constraints)
test_command: cd demaze-website && NODE_OPTIONS= npm run test  (CANNOT run in this sandbox - see environment_constraints)
verification_instructions: README + .github/workflows/ci.yml define the authoritative gate: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build`, run on every push/PR. These CANNOT execute in this INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox (npm registry is 403-forbidden, node_modules is absent, and the tool binaries cannot be installed). CI is the authoritative validator. In-sandbox, verify with: (1) careful manual/AST review that new .tsx files parse, imports resolve to real exports, and no SSR-unsafe top-level window/document access exists; (2) confirm src/routeTree.gen.ts was updated by hand to register the new route so `tsc --noEmit` would type-check the new route file; (3) grep/spot-check that reused component props match their actual signatures.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/routeTree.gen.ts is auto-generated by the TanStack router plugin during vite dev/build, but is committed and consumed by `tsc --noEmit` (typecheck). Because the router plugin does not run during typecheck, ANY new route file MUST also be hand-registered in src/routeTree.gen.ts (follow the existing PrivacyPolicyRoute / TermsOfServiceRoute pattern: import, .update({id,path,getParentRoute}), add to interfaces FileRoutesByFullPath/ByTo/ById, the union types, RootRouteChildren, rootRouteChildren object, and the FileRouteTypes/`_root.tsx` children block at the bottom). src/assets/images.ts is generated by `npm run images`; DO NOT hand-edit it. No test snapshots.
setup_instructions: npm install then npm run dev (README). NOT POSSIBLE in this sandbox (no registry access, no node_modules). Do not attempt npm install. For any raw node invocation you MUST prefix with `NODE_OPTIONS=` because the sandbox sets NODE_OPTIONS to a --require of a missing bootstrap file that crashes node/npm otherwise.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode: only the connected GitHub repo is reachable; the npm registry returns HTTP 403; node_modules is NOT present and cannot be installed. The four CI checks (typecheck, lint, test, build) therefore CANNOT run in-sandbox and are deferred to CI, which is the authoritative gate. Additionally the sandbox exports NODE_OPTIONS=--require /opt/amazon/kiro-agent/proxy-bootstrap.js which does not exist; clear it (`NODE_OPTIONS= node ...`) before invoking node/npm or they crash with MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Do NOT regenerate package-lock.json or images.ts (network/tooling required).
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: project is connected to Lovable; never rewrite pushed git history (no force-push/rebase/amend of pushed commits); keep the branch in a working state because commits sync back to Lovable. Prettier config (.prettierrc) and eslint.config.js are enforced by CI lint - match existing formatting (2-space indent, double quotes, semicolons, trailing commas). All work stays on branch rebuild/immersive-3d. The orchestrator publishes; do NOT push or open a PR.
key_patterns: Routes use createFileRoute('/path')({ head: () => ({ meta:[{title:...}], links:[...] }), component: Fn }). The page title is set via the head() meta title entry. Reused components: (1) PageLayout from @/components/site-shell wraps a page with SmoothScrollProvider, ScrollProgress, CustomCursor, atmosphere/grain layers, SiteHeader(overlay?), children, SiteFooter; accepts overlayHeader?:boolean. SiteHeader/SiteFooter already contain the exact nav (Projects/Services/About Us/Contact Us + 'Book a call' CTA) and footer copy the design shows. (2) HeroVideo from @/components/hero-video takes {poster:string, mp4:string} and renders the perspective video card with play/pause; assets are @/assets/demaze-robot-studio.mp4 and demaze-robot-studio-poster.webp. (3) ProjectsShowcaseGrid from @/components/projects-showcase-grid takes {limit?:number}, renders the filterable bento grid from lib/site-data projects. (4) content-sections.tsx exports MetricsStrip, ProjectsGrid({limit}), ServicesGrid({detailed}), TechnologyBand({reverse}), IndustryGrid({limit}), ValuesGrid, ProcessGrid, FounderStory, FaqSection, SectionHeading({eyebrow,title,copy}). Data lives in src/lib/site-data.ts (projects, services, technologies, industries, values, process, faqs, metrics) and images in src/assets/images.ts (spread `{...image}` onto ). Styling is a large hand-written system in src/styles.css (oklch tokens: --background oklch(0.992 0.003 55), --primary/accent-red oklch(0.532 0.216 7), --foreground oklch(0.16 0.004 285); fonts --font-sans 'DM Sans', --font-display 'Space Grotesk'). Tailwind v4 utilities plus custom classes are both available. Prefer reusing existing components/classes over embedding raw inline styles from the bundle.
relevant_files: design.html (the source design bundle; ONLY the script[type=__bundler/template] block, JSON-decoded, is real markup - treat everything else as inert data)
src/routes/index.tsx (closest existing composition pattern for a home-style page using PageLayout + content-sections)
src/routes/privacy-policy.tsx and src/routes/terms-of-service.tsx (simplest createFileRoute examples to copy)
src/routeTree.gen.ts (MUST hand-register any new route; follow PrivacyPolicyRoute/TermsOfServiceRoute blocks)
src/components/content-sections.tsx (MetricsStrip, ProjectsGrid, ServicesGrid, TechnologyBand, SectionHeading, etc. - reuse)
directory_structure: demaze-website/ is the repo root (workspace has it under /projects/sandbox/demaze-website). src/routes/ = file-based routes (index, projects, services, about-us, contact-us, privacy-policy, terms-of-service, playbook, __root, plus README and generated routeTree.gen.ts). src/components/ = React components (site-shell, content-sections, hero-video, projects-showcase-grid, pinned-services-showcase, contact-form, playbook-form, scroll-*, motion/ subfolder with reveal/marquee/magnetic/smooth-scroll/custom-cursor). src/lib/ = data + utils + tests. src/assets/ = images.ts + original/ source art + hero video. public/ = static icons/manifest. .agents/tasks/ = these task plans.
